# Track Credits

## pulse-120.mp3

**Type:** Procedurally-generated click-track placeholder  
**Source:** Generated by ffmpeg using the `aevalsrc` filter  
**License:** CC0 / Public Domain  

**Generation command:**
```bash
ffmpeg -f lavfi \
  -i "aevalsrc=0.5*sin(2*PI*880*t)*lt(mod(t\,0.5)\,0.03):d=6" \
  -ar 44100 -ac 2 public/assets/tracks/pulse-120.mp3 -y
```

This generates a ~6-second stereo MP3 containing 880 Hz sine-wave clicks at 120 BPM (one click every 0.5 s), created entirely by ffmpeg with no third-party audio assets. The mathematical expression produces silence except for the first 30 ms of each half-second window, creating a click on each beat.

## Important Notice

**This is a placeholder track for development and testing only.**

Production deployments MUST replace this file with a properly-licensed royalty-free audio track. Suitable sources include:

- [Freesound.org](https://freesound.org) — CC0 and CC BY licensed sounds
- [ccMixter](http://ccmixter.org) — CC-licensed music
- [Free Music Archive](https://freemusicarchive.org) — various CC licenses
- Commissioned original music with explicit license grant

Ensure any replacement track is cleared for commercial use if applicable.
